LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Become the Ultimate Warrior Mage - Wield mighty weapons and unleash devastating magic as you grapple, glide, fight, and explore across a mysterious world.

Discover Legendary Weapons - The Master Sword. The Lich Hammer. There are whispers of many more. Find them and their powers are yours: each with unique traits suiting a variety of different playstyles.

Unlock Ancient Magic - Soul Crests are ancient magic items that hold the essence of long-forgotten warriors. Collect them to learn their power: and live your wildest battlemage fantasies.

A Lovingly Crafted Metroidvania World - Grapple, Glide, Summon Platforms and more! Find Artifices to unlock the world and discover its deepest secrets. Experience the thrill of exploration with the challenge of platforming.
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: Discover the secrets of a sundered world as you help Aryn save his comrades in this story-rich, fully-voiced, 2.5D action-platformer. Fight terrible dangers and explore ancient mysteries as Aryn uncovers the forces that forge his destiny.

Features: Fully-voiced story. Every line of dialogue is performed by a talented cast of voice actors.
A living world, where each biome has its own theme, lore, dangers, and challenges.
Interconnected map. Explore as you wish. Gain abilities to unlock areas. Find shortcuts, hidden passages, and more.
Quests, quests everywhere! Find characters to help and mysteries to solve throughout the world. But beware: your choices have consequences.
Memorable boss fights. Bosses will test you to your limits. Beating them will require skill, tactical-thinking, and unlocking the full potential of your weapons and powers
Choose your build. Equip weapons and powers to create a build that reflects your playstyle. Each weapon has hidden powers that can be unlocked by defeating enemies.
LocalizedProperties.MinimumNotes: Windows 8/10/11;Intel i5 10th Gen or AMD equivelent;nVidia GeForce 960 or AMD Equivelent;DirectX 12;Disk Space 15 GB
LocalizedProperties.ReleaseNotes:
v1.450 PATCH NOTES

Darkness (Lantern) Mechanic Fixes:
- Fixed darkness collapse sometimes killing the player after leaving a darkness area.
- Fixed darkness collapse continuing after a hazard respawn outside the area.
- Fixed lingering darkness effects after the Gloomwraith fight ends.
- Darkness collapse now stops correctly when darkness areas are disabled or removed.
- Safe beacons now protect the player more reliably during respawns and encounter transitions.
- Prevented darkness deaths during cutscenes, menus, and other temporary gameplay transitions.
- Improved overall reliability of Aura Lantern and safe-beacon protection.

Achievements Updates:
- Improved the treasure achievement fix to ensure eligible players receive it without affecting their treasure progress.
- Improved compatibility with existing save files.
